questions.question:
[지문]
Bobby got his name from his grandfather, Bob. Bob was his best friend. Bob was the person who taught Bobby how to walk. "Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said.
"Now one foot, now the other."
Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower.
"There is one more block to put," Bob said.
"And that's the elephant block," Bobby said.
Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell. Bobby laughed and laughed. Bobby said, "You always sneeze when the elephant block appears."

다음 글을 읽고 밥(Bob)에 대해 추론할 수 있는 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 Bob이 Bobby를 가르치고(taught), 함께 놀고(played), 웃음(laughed)을 나누는 모습을 볼 수 있으므로, Bob은 playful and friendly한 인물이다.

options: The scene takes place on a warm day.
Bob and Bobby were sitting next to each other.
Bob stood up slowly with Bobby's help.
Bob said "Now one foot" and Bobby repeated it.
Bob moved his feet one by one as Bobby said.
questions.question:
[지문]
When the weather got nice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat side by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing.
"You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said.
Then, Bob stood up very slowly. Bobby smiled and stood in front of Bob. Bob leaned on Bobby's shoulders.
Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby added, "Now one foot."
Like magic, Bob moved one foot.
"Now the other."
And Bob moved the other.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 "Bobby said, 'Now one foot'"이고 "Bob moved one foot"이다. 따라서 Bob이 "Now one foot"을 말한 것이 아니라 Bobby가 말했으므로, 4번이 일치하지 않는다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Time passed. One day, Bobby's dad looked very ⓐ sad. He told Bobby,
"Bob fell ill. He is in a hospital which is far from here."
"I want to see him," Bobby said.
"You can't, Bobby," Mom told him. "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't talk. We'll just have to wait and hope that he will get ⓑ sicker."
Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks.
"Bob, it's time to build a tower!"
Bob's mouth made a small ⓒ smile. Bobby began to build the tower.
"Okay, Bob, now the elephant block."
Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would ⓓ recover soon. And Bob did. ⓔ Slowly, Bob began to talk a little and move his fingers. But he still couldn't walk.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓑ 'sicker'는 문맥상 맞지 않다. "get better"가 되어야 한다. Bob이 병에 걸렸는데 더 심해지기를 바랄 리 없으므로, '더 건강해지기를'의 의미로 'better'가 적절하다.

questions.explanation: (D) 'pushed'는 문맥상 적절하지 않다. "Bob leaned on Bobby's shoulders"이 맞는 표현이어야 하므로, 'pushed'가 아니라 'leaned'가 적절하다.

questions.question:

다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

When the weather got nice and warm, Bob and Bobby (A) [sat / sitting] side by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing. "You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said. Then, Bob stood up very slowly. Bobby smiled and stood in front of Bob. Bob (B) [leaned / leaning] on Bobby's shoulders. Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby (C) [added / adding], "Now one foot." Like magic, Bob moved one foot. "Now the other." And Bob moved the other.
questions.explanation: (A) 과거사건을 나열하므로 과거형 'sat' 사용. (B) 과거사건이므로 'leaned' 사용. (C) 과거사건이므로 'added' 사용. 세 동사 모두 과거형으로 통일되어야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks ⓐone by one to build a tower. "There is one more block ⓑto put," Bob said. "And that's the elephant block," Bobby said. Bobby ⓒcarefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell.
Time passed. One day, Bobby's dad looked very ⓓsadly. He told Bobby, "Bob fell ill. He is in a hospital which is far from here." "I want to see him," Bobby said. "You can't, Bobby," Mom told him. "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't talk. We'll just have to wait and ⓔhope that he will get better."
questions.explanation: ⓓ 'looked very sadly'는 잘못된 표현이다. 'looked'는 연결동사이므로 뒤에 형용사가 와야 한다. 따라서 'looked very sad'가 올바른 표현이다. 'sadly'는 부사로 'looked'를 수식할 수 없다.
